title: Between the World and Me
author: Ta-Nehisi Coates
summary: Written as a letter to his teenage son, Ta-Nehisi Coates reflects on growing up in Baltimore and what it means to live in a Black body in America. He examines fear, history and the loss of friends to violence.
readIf: you want a personal, lyrical essay on race in America.
skipIf: you prefer policy-focused argument over personal and poetic reflection.
